title: Parameter-Controlled Regime Transitions in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Cross-Sector Consistency Between Lensing and Background Observables
abstract: This paper analyzes how the sealed EFC lensing engine’s Σ_eff(z) crossover is controlled by model parameters and cross-validates robustness across power-spectrum choices. It finds that the kinetic stiffness scale K0 dominantly sets the redshift of the predicted sign-changing lensing coupling (z× ≈ 0.44), while amplitude parameters have minor impact, and documents qualitative µ < 1 agreement between the lensing and growth sectors. It pre-registers a falsification framework linking the non-monotonic lensing signature to growth and EG tests for upcoming Euclid DR1 and DESI DR2 data.
